simple.meaning: נָמֵר (nâmêr) is a Hebrew word meaning “a leopard (from its stripes).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: נָמֵר (H5246) appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Song of Songs 4:8, with occurrences in Song of Solomon, Isaiah, Jeremiah, Hosea, Habakkuk.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נָמֵר (H5246) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in נָמֵר (H5246) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: נָמֵר (nâmêr) / H5246 is traced through Song of Songs 4:8, Isaiah 11:6, Jeremiah 5:6, Jeremiah 13:23 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

timeline.evidenceText: The wolf will live with the lamb,

Therefore a lion out of the forest will kill them. A wolf of the evenings will destroy them. A leopard will watch against their cities. Everyone who goes out there will be torn in pieces, because their transgressions are many and their backsliding has increased.
Can the Ethiopian change his skin,
Therefore I am like a lion to them.

Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves. Their horsemen press proudly on. Yes, their horsemen come from afar. They fly as an eagle that hurries to devour.

definitions.full: H5246. namer נָמֵר noun masculine Isa 11:6 leopard ; — absolute ׳נ Hosea 13:7 3 t.; plural נְמֵרִים Hab 1:8 ; Song 4:8 ; — leopard , as spotted Jer 13:23 , swift Hab 1:8 , keen-eyed Jer 5:6 (symbol of calamities of Israel), so Hosea 13:7 (simile of ׳י ); ׳נ יִרְבָּ֑ץ עִםגְּֿדִי Isa 11:6 (predict); נְמֵרִים חַרֲרֵי Song 4:8 (|| אֲרָיוֺת מְעֹנוֺת ).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning properly, to filtrate , i.e. be limpid (comp 5247 and 5249 ); and thus to spot or stain as if by dripping;
